evidence: Implements BIP 54 soft fork consensus validation logic across src/validation.cpp, src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, and related headers.
rationale: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules on regtest to resolve quadratic legacy sigop CPU exhaustion, Merkle tree collisions (CVE-2017-12842), and timewarp attacks.
